title: How to Govern AI: Foundations and Practical Guide to AI Governance
description:
A practitioner's guide to governing artificial intelligence across its full lifecycle: scoping and inventory, risk classification, data governance, model selection and development, testing and red-teaming, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and the governance of generative and agentic systems. It reads the EU AI Act, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001 and sector regulation against each other, and turns them into the artifacts and decisions an organization actually has to produce.

This edition supersedes Governing AI: Leading Responsible Innovation (v1.5.2), whose final version remains citable at doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18407350.
